name: The H̶i̶t̶m̶a̶n̶ Hero Happened Upon His Own Homie Harem?!
source:
Yu Q. Wilson is a student at Nijisanji Hero Academy. Surrounded by the best friends a hero could ask for, will something more develop between him and one of the homies?

"The H̶i̶t̶m̶a̶n̶ Hero Happened Upon His Own Homie Harem?!" is a short, unofficial fanmade visual novel starring Yu Q. Wilson from Nijisanji EN's 8th wave Krisis!

[From [url=https://yoowinn.itch.io/homie-harem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Yu Q. Wilson是二十三寺英雄学院的学生。周围都是英雄所能要求的最好的朋友，他和其中一位兄弟之间会发展出更多的东西吗？

“H̶i̶t̶m̶a̶n̶英雄竟然出现在自己的闺蜜后宫？！”是一部由粉丝制作的短篇视觉小说，由来自Nijisanji EN的第8波危机的Yu Q. Wilson主演！

[来自[url=https://yoowinn.itch.io/homie-harem]itch.io[/url]]
